inventory_source: doc/reviews/2038-specification-audit/shards/file_only_reference_assertions_current/inventory.json (69 supplemental file references; each matching ledger row also has named sibling tests)
selection: Five non-overlapping rows sampled for trust/security-relevant parser, decoder, evaluator, image-dictionary, and signature claims. The parent shard already sampled §7.3.8.1, §8.6.4.2, and §9.3.6.

features.source_location: Primary PDF physical 45 / printed 30; Dictionary objects, direct keys/null semantics and unordered entries.
features.actual_file_assertions: damaged_page_dictionaries.rs uses explicit malformed-prefix fixtures to test a separate page-enumeration recovery route, with intact-page, reachable-tree, declaration-present and declaration-absent controls. It asserts page count, inherited MediaBox and recovered-entry count; it is not a general parser dictionary-conformance test.
features.adr_and_scope: ADR 0784/0786 bound page recovery to empty/broken-tree cases; ADR 0858 documents first-duplicate retention as local malformed-input policy because source dictionary order is irrelevant. Recovery is not a normative obligation.
features.verdict: The file pointer is supplemental and accurately paired with named dictionary assertions. The named assertions cover null-as-absence and duplicate handling, while the file covers specialized recovery. No gap or source-conformance inference from its filename alone.

features.source_location: Primary PDF physical 60–61 / printed 45–46; JBIG2Decode restrictions, JBIG2Globals and embedded sequential organization.
features.actual_file_assertions: fixed_documents.rs is a corpus-reproduction harness checking recorded report and raster/ink outcomes for previously fixed files; it is supplemental and can depend on machine-local witnesses. Named JBIG2 tests decode explicit coding-mode fixtures, an extended-template witness, and T.88 streams against reference bitmaps.
features.adr_and_scope: ADRs 0014 (confined decoder worker), 1459 (extended template), 1485 (arithmetic sequence) and 2102 (dependency fork/review) are relevant. Source restricts producer streams to bitonal, page 1, embedded sequential organization, no file header/end-page/end-file markers, and separately stored globals; it does not prescribe general reader rejection for every producer violation.
features.verdict: Supplementary corpus gate has one stale font expectation D51; default suite skips it. JBIG97-file comparison and extended-template witness execute andPASS. T88 initially returnsPASS with no data, then actual official reference executionPASS; see separate shard for assertion limits.

features.source_location: EC3 physical147 / printed132 for actual input/output/stack rules; §7.10.5.3 starts physical146.
features.actual_file_assertions: The model file exercises input-dependent wrong output count, boolean output and stack-overflow functions through tint, image, transfer, black-generation, mesh and shading consumers, paired with conforming controls. Evaluator unit tests distinguish errors provable on every run from runtime faults. MAX_STACK is 1000: tests hit its overflow boundary; the standard requires at least 100 and explicitly requires no implementation to provide more.
features.adr_and_scope: ADRs 2833/2848 explain deferred runtime faults and surfacing them through active consumer paths. The producer brace-nesting constraint is separate from evaluator stack behavior.
features.verdict: Good assertion linkage. The 1000-entry limit is a chosen implementation bound above the source minimum, not an ISO maximum. No missing minimum-capacity control or defect was found.

features.source_location: Primary PDF physical 273–274 / printed 258–259; Table 87 image entries and the rule that inconsistent entries shall cause an error.
features.actual_file_assertions: Dictionary-consistency fixtures have exact xref entries and a valid DeviceRGB positive control that paints literal red; each malformed Decode length differs only by pair count and must be incomplete. Image-mask tests separately assert asymmetric stencil pixels, reversed Decode, and explicit/color-key masking.
features.adr_and_scope: ADR 0023 treats explicit/color-key masking as source-defined mechanisms. Current checks are in image dispatch/space/mask code and named consistency tests; no host-device color is the oracle in the malformed-length tests.
features.verdict: File references are broad supplemental suites; named tests link the specific source checks. Literal valid pixels and completeness controls discriminate. No missing assertion found.

features.source_location: Primary PDF physical 582–583 / printed 567–568; signature-handler verification, digest recomputation, ByteRange and signature kinds.
features.actual_file_assertions: The fixture is a genuinely signed detached CMS PDF using a test private key/root. The positive checks integrity, signature authenticity, anchored path, explicit revocation acceptance, and timestamp state. Negative controls use a different/no anchor, changed bytes, unchecked revocation under the default policy, and a broken policy constraint. Valid carries the established path/revocation/time evidence; a digest alone is not validity.
features.adr_and_scope: ADRs 0229, 0472 and 1067 preserve the distinction among integrity, authenticity, anchored trust and revocation. Revocation/time subfeatures are separately audited and not recertified here.
features.verdict: The file reference supplements exact named positive and negative controls and is well-linked to the validity claim. It does not certify every signature profile or imply network revocation checking. No gap was found in this sample.

limitations: Six exact file-only pointers across five rows reviewed, not every reference in those rows or all69 pointers. Parent ran selected JBIG/image/T88 and the explicit ignored fixed-document gate; see parent-review and D51. Other assertion reading is not fresh execution.
